open_points.subject: A21 security review after A13 gained Required test 13
open_points.text: Reviewed under authentication_credential_abuse (A13): the test shows a refusal A13 rule 6 already gave; no category's references changed.
open_points.question: A21 rule 2 says a change to a decision reopens every category that names it, and the Security review names A13 under authentication_credential_abuse, browser_boundary and concurrency; were browser_boundary and concurrency reviewed too, and what were their outcomes?
options: Record that authentication_credential_abuse, browser_boundary and concurrency were all reopened and reviewed, with the outcome of each unchanged.
State an explicit exception under which adding a Required test without changing behavior reopens only the category whose question the test directly addresses.
Treat the quoted sentence as implicitly recording all three reviews even though it names only authentication_credential_abuse.
open_points.default_guess: Record all three named categories as reopened and reviewed, with unchanged outcomes.

witness.initial: A21 names A13 as a reference of authentication_credential_abuse, browser_boundary and concurrency, and A21 rule 2 says: "A change to a decision a category names reopens this review."
events: The owner adds Required test 13 to A13.
The new A21 passage records review only under authentication_credential_abuse.
A later reviewer or gate must decide whether A21 is closed.
outcomes: The reviewer accepts the recorded authentication_credential_abuse review as sufficient and closes A21.
The reviewer applies rule 2 to every category naming A13 and requires recorded browser_boundary and concurrency reviews before closing A21.
witness.observer: the State 2 security-review gate and later agents deciding whether A21 is complete
